description: This file defines a client class for managing models via a REST API, including methods for listing, creating, deleting, retrieving, updating models, and fetching model info. It handles HTTP requests and exceptions, and is part of a proxy client module.

classes.name: ModelsManagementClient
classes.description: A client class for managing models through REST API calls, supporting operations like list, create, delete, get, info, and update.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the client with base URL and optional API key.

methods.name: _get_headers
methods.description: Constructs headers for API requests, including authorization if API key is set.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of supported models or returns a prepared request.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Adds a new model to the proxy server.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific model by ID or name.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Fetches detailed info about all models.
